trap.label: accuse of
trap.wrong: The prosecuting counsel accused him for theft.
trap.right: The prosecuting counsel accused him of theft.
trap.why: Em português “acusar de” é natural, mas o aluno alterna com for. Em inglês, accuse someone of something.

mcq.q: The council “claims” costs fell, which means...

fix.wrong: The minister assert that costs fell.
fix.right: The minister asserts that costs fell.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com allege: “Prosecutors say, without proof, that he stole.”
Reescreva com accused of: “Counsel says he committed theft.”
Reescreva com assert: “The minister firmly stated that costs fell.”
rewrite.answer: The minister asserted that costs fell.
